jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>About Tekion:</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><h1>Software Architect (Frontend)</h1> <h2>Job Introduction</h2> <p>The Software Architect – Frontend is responsible for leading the design, architecture, and implementation of modern, scalable, and maintainable frontend applications across our product suite. This role collaborates cross-functionally with designers, backend engineers, and product managers to ensure a seamless and consistent user experience, driving the adoption of best practices in <li>Stay up to date with emerging trends in frontend development, evaluating their relevance and potential impact.</li> <li>Maintain thorough documentation of frontend architecture, workflows, and best practices.</li> </ul> <h2>Basic Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>8+ years of professional jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>About Tekion:</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><h2>Job Introduction</h2> <p>The Software Platform Architect is responsible for the high-level design, development, and evolution of scalable software platforms that support multiple products and business needs. This role collaborates with cross-functional teams—including engineering, product, and operations—to define technology standards, guide architectural decisions, and ensure the platform’s reliability, scalability, and security.</p> <h2>Key Role and Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead the architecture and design of Integration and System Integrator Platform platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical strategy.</li> <li>Define and promote the use of architectural patterns, best practices, and standards across the engineering organization.</li> <li>Collaborate with development teams to translate business requirements into robust, scalable, and modular solutions.</li> <li>Evaluate and select appropriate technologies, frameworks, and tools to meet platform needs.</li> <li>Oversee integration with internal and third-party systems, ensuring data integrity and optimal performance.</li> <li>Conduct architecture reviews and provide technical guidance to engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle.</li> <li>Identify and address potential bottlenecks, vulnerabilities, and system failures.</li> <li>Maintain documentation of architecture, processes, and best practices.</li> <li>Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating their potential impact on the platform.</li> <li>Mentor and coach engineering teams on architectural principles and practices.</li> </ul> <h2>Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related field.</li> <li>Experience in building at event driven applications at scale</li> <li>10+ years of relevant experience in software development and architecture, with a focus on building platforms or large-scale systems.</li> <li>Experience is large scale messaging systems like Kafka</li> <li>Experience using Mongodb, Elastic Search, My SQL, Postgresql</li> <li>Proven experience in building platform components using the java, Spring Boot.</li> <li>Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).</li> <li>Strong knowledge of APIs, microservices, data storage, and integration methodologies.</li> <li>Experience in Saa S platform architecture or development.</li> <li>Familiarity with Dev Ops practices and CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li>Experience with security, compliance, and regulatory requirements for enterprise software.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.</li> <li>Experience working in Agile environments.</li> <li>Experience in using AI tools (Augment, Cursor, Claude code)</li> </ul> <h2>Perks and Benefits</h2> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation.</li> <li>Generous stock options.</li> <li>Medical Insurance coverage.</li> <li>Work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley’s most dominant and successful companies.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. title: Associate Principal Graphic Designer
jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><h2 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>About Tekion:</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><h2>Job Description</h2> <p>We need an Associate Principal Graphic Designer who can think strategically and ship great work. You'll manage our brand's visual identity across all digital channels and work directly with the communication team, marketing, and leadership to create designs that connect with our audience. You'll mentor the design team, maintain quality standards, and help build the way we work. This role fits someone who wants to lead, create, and grow a design practice at a technology company that moves fast.</p> <h2>Key Role and Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Brand Vision &amp; Consistency: You'll maintain our brand's visual standards and build the design systems that keep everything consistent. That means creating guidelines, components, and patterns that work across all platforms
- so every project reinforces the brand without starting from scratch.</li> <li>End-to-End Creative Leadership: You'll own design projects from start to finish across web, mobile, and marketing campaigns. That means taking concepts from initial ideas through final launch. You'll work with communications, marketing, product, and leadership to create designs that look sharp and move business metrics
- whether that's revenue, adoption, or conversion.</li> <li>Ideation &amp; Storytelling: You'll research concepts and turn them into working designs. Then you'll present your work to different teams
- product, marketing, leadership
- and explain the thinking behind your JD
- Associate Principle Graphic Designer 1 choices. That means showing why certain design decisions solve specific problems, not just what looks good. You need to make your case clearly whether you're talking to designers or marketers or executives.&nbsp;</li> <li>Team Leadership &amp; Growth: You'll manage a small design team and help them grow. That means coaching designers on their projects, giving feedback that improves their work, and building accountability around quality. The goal is creating a design powerhouse where people own their craft and keep getting better at it. Holistic Design Oversight: You'll review all design work before it ships
- product interfaces, illustrations, brand materials, presentations, and campaign visuals. That means maintaining quality standards across everything and making sure it all feels consistent. Nothing goes out without your approval.</li> <li>Systems &amp; Workflow Innovation: You'll build design systems and workflows that make the team more efficient. As we grow, you'll keep improving how we work
- finding ways to move faster without dropping quality. The goal is scaling output while keeping the work sharp.</li> <li>Strategic Design Advocacy: You'll represent design in leadership meetings and cross-functional discussions. That means explaining design decisions to executives and showing how they connect to business goals
- whether that's Brand perception, revenue, adoption, or user retention. You'll need to make the case for design quality and user experience when priorities compete.</li> </ul> <h2 data-renderer-start-pos="1035" data-local-id="7bdc1d19584f">Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>9+ years of hands-on visual and brand design experience in tech or Saa S, with a portfolio that shows clear thinking, strong storytelling, and high craft.</li> <li>A track record of leading or managing designers on real projects, with experience owning outcomes, not just visuals.</li> <li>Deep expertise in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, plus comfort exploring new tools for motion, prototyping, and collaboration.</li> <li>Proven ability to build and evolve brand identities, logos, and web experiences that can scale across enterprise audiences and channels.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong communication skills with real executive presence: you can defend your work with clarity, invite feedback, and align teams around a shared vision.</li> <li>Experience running projects end to end, from brief and discovery through delivery, with a structured approach to planning, prioritizing, and followthrough.</li> <li>A habit of staying ahead of design, product, and culture trends, and turning that curiosity into concrete ideas we can ship.</li> <li>High personal accountability: you take ownership, push for better outcomes, and hold yourself and others to a strong quality bar.</li> <li>Genuine passion for design and storytelling, and a desire to grow a small team into a tight, proud, high-performing creative group.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>Perks and Benefits</h2> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Generous stock options</li> <li>Medical Insurance coverage</li> <li>Work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley’s most dominant and successful companies</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. That means creating guidelines, components, and patterns that work across all platforms - so every project reinforces the brand without starting from scratch.</li> <li>End-to-End Creative Leadership: You'll own design projects from start to finish across web, mobile, and marketing campaigns. That means taking concepts from initial ideas through final launch. You'll work with communications, marketing, product, and leadership to create designs that look sharp and move business metrics - whether that's revenue, adoption, or conversion.</li> <li>Ideation &amp; Storytelling: You'll research concepts and turn them into working designs. That means showing why certain design decisions solve specific problems, not just what looks good. Holistic Design Oversight: You'll review all design work before it ships - product interfaces, illustrations, brand materials, presentations, and campaign visuals. That means maintaining quality standards across everything and making sure it all feels consistent. Nothing goes out without your approval.</li> <li>Systems &amp; Workflow Innovation: You'll build design systems and workflows that make the team more efficient. The goal is scaling output while keeping the work sharp.</li> <li>Strategic Design Advocacy: You'll represent design in leadership meetings and cross-functional discussions. That means explaining design decisions to executives and showing how they connect to business goals - whether that's Brand perception, revenue, adoption, or user retention. documentation, and internal processes.</li> <li>Research and respond to technical questions related to OEM service information, repair procedures, labor operations, and automotive parts.</li> </ul> operations, and service documentation.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using OEM Service Manuals, Electronic Parts Catalogs (Parts Catalog), Dealer Management Systems (DMS), and automotive parts inventory systems.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of automotive spare parts identification, parts catalog navigation, and maintenance service requirements.</li> <li>Experience working with Microsoft Excel and Automotive datas management.</li> <li>Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail with a commitment to data quality and accuracy.</li> <li>Effective written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.</li> </ul> jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>About Tekion:</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><h2>Job Introduction&nbsp;</h2> <p>We are seeking a Principal Applied Scientist to be the highest-level AI technical authority on the team. This role is above the Applied Scientist level — you set the AI research and engineering direction, own the agentic system architecture, define the eval framework standards, and operate as the primary interface to the external AI research community and internal platform AI leadership. You will combine deep research rigor with relentless production focus: every AI capability you design ships, gets measured, and improves based on evidence.</p> <p>You are the person who answers: "Is this AI approach the right one, and how do we know when it's working"</p> <h2>Key Role &amp; Responsibilities&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li>Own the agentic system architecture: define the multi-agent coordination patterns, MCP tool taxonomy, intent-to-skill routing logic, policy enforcement design, and memory management strategy across all AI workflows on the platform.</li> <li>Lead the AI evaluation framework: design the golden dataset structure, define eval metrics (RAG retrieval quality, scoring accuracy, LLM response correctness, agentic workflow success rate), and own the CI/CD AI eval pipeline that gates every AI capability release.</li> <li>Drive the RAG architecture strategy: chunking strategies for Mongo DB and Elasticsearch-indexed documents, embedding model selection and fine-tuning, retrieval reranking design, and hallucination mitigation patterns.</li> <li>Own the LLM integration architecture: prompt engineering standards, LLM gateway usage policies, context window management, streaming response patterns, and model version governance.</li> <li>Lead applied research initiatives: identify novel techniques (RLHF, Constitutional AI, multi-modal, sparse retrieval) that are practically applicable to automotive retail intelligence use cases and prototype them rigorously in Python.</li> <li>Define the hexagonal AI adapter contract standard: the formal interface specification between Python AI services and Java domain cores — ensuring AI infrastructure remains swappable without domain logic changes.</li> <li>Act as primary technical interface to platform AI leadership (LLM Gateway, ML Platform, Agentic Engine) — influencing platform roadmap based on teams practical requirements.</li> <li>Mentor the Applied Scientist and ML Architect; conduct technical reviews of AI system designs, eval frameworks, and research approaches.</li> <li>Publish, present, or contribute to open-source where appropriate — representing Tekion's AI engineering excellence externally.</li> </ul> <h2>Basic Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>10+ years of applied AI/ML experience with at least 3 years at Staff or Principal level — a track record of shipping AI systems that measurably changed business outcomes.</li> <li>Deep expertise across: LLM fine-tuning and alignment, RAG system design (chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking), agentic frameworks (Lang Graph, Crew AI, Auto Gen), and MCP tool design.</li> <li>Python mastery: Py Torch, Hugging Face Transformers, Lang Chain/Lang Graph, scikit-learn, and production ML serving tooling.</li> <li>Strong understanding of distributed AI systems: Elasticsearch-backed vector search, Redis/Aerospike serving, Cosmos DB for AI event logging, and Kafka-based feature pipelines.</li> <li>Proven ability to design formal eval frameworks for AI systems — not just accuracy metrics but business aligned quality gates.</li> <li>Experience defining and enforcing hexagonal adapter contracts between AI services and domain service layers in production systems.</li> <li>Track record of communicating complex AI system design to non-technical stakeholders, influencing product roadmaps, and driving cross-team alignment.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>Preferred Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Publications or significant open-source contributions in NLP, information retrieval, or agentic systems.</li> <li>Experience with Constitutional AI, RLAIF, or preference optimization techniques (DPO, PPO).</li> <li>Familiarity with multi-modal AI and its application to automotive retail data (images, documents, tabular data fusion).</li> <li>Prior experience in a product-focused AI role at a Saa S or platform company — not purely research.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>Perks &amp; title: Product Manager II
jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>About Tekion:</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><p></p> <p><strong>Product&nbsp;Manager&nbsp;II</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:&nbsp;Bengaluru,&nbsp;India</strong></p> <p><strong>ABOUT TEKION</strong></p> <p>Tekion is positively disrupting an industry that has seen little meaningful innovation in over 50 years. With the first cloud-native Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) and Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC), Tekion connects OEMs, dealers, and consumers through a single unified platform powered by real-time data, machine learning, and AI. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe, and is trusted by 1,700+ dealership rooftops globally.</p> <p><strong>ROLE OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a technically grounded and detail-oriented Product Manager II to own the Retail module and Core application layer within Tekion's Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) platform. This is a platform-facing product role — you will bridge the gap between OEM program requirements and Tekion's engineering organisation, ensuring that complex business needs from GM, Honda, and other OEM partners are translated into well-defined, scalable platform capabilities.</p> <p>Your primary ownership spans vehicle configuration and inventory, deal structuring workflows, and the Core platform layer — including login, SSO, user roles, and permissions. You will partner closely with OEM program teams to understand requirements first-hand and work with platform engineering to spec, prioritise, and deliver features that meet OEM certification standards while remaining extensible across the platform.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <p><strong>• Own the AEC Retail Module Roadmap</strong></p> <p><em>Define and maintain the product roadmap for vehicle configuration, inventory management, and deal structuring workflows within the AEC platform. Translate OEM program requirements into a prioritised, execution-ready backlog.</em></p> <p><strong>• Drive Core Platform Product Ownership</strong></p> <p><em>Own the Core application layer — including user authentication (login/SSO), role-based access control (RBAC), permissions frameworks, and cross-module platform services. Ensure these foundations are robust, configurable, and OEM-certifiable.</em></p> <p><strong>• Translate OEM Requirements into Platform Specifications</strong></p> <p><em>Act as the primary product interface between OEM program teams (GM, Honda, and others) and Tekion's platform engineering organisation. Convert OEM business and functional requirements into clearly scoped platform features, API contracts, and data models.</em></p> <p><strong>• Own the Scrum Team Backlog</strong></p> <p><em>Write precise user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature specs for your engineering squad. Maintain a groomed, well-prioritised backlog that balances OEM program commitments, platform health, and roadmap investments.</em></p> <p><strong>• Define Vehicle Configuration &amp; Inventory Data Contracts</strong></p> <p><em>Collaborate with engineering and data teams to design configuration schemas, inventory data feeds, and pricing rule structures that support multi-OEM requirements while remaining scalable and maintainable.</em></p> <p><strong>• Support Deal Structuring Workflow Design</strong></p> <p><em>Understand and document end-to-end deal structuring flows — from vehicle selection and option pricing through to deal presentation — ensuring feature decisions align with both OEM program rules and dealer operational needs.</em></p> <p><strong>• Drive Cross-Functional Alignment</strong></p> <p><em>Coordinate&nbsp;across&nbsp;OEM&nbsp;program&nbsp;teams,&nbsp;platform&nbsp;engineering,&nbsp;and&nbsp;internal&nbsp;business&nbsp;stakeholders&nbsp;to&nbsp;resolve&nbsp;requirement&nbsp;conflicts,&nbsp;manage&nbsp;dependencies,&nbsp;and&nbsp;maintain&nbsp;shared&nbsp;delivery&nbsp;timelines.</em></p> <p><strong>• Track Feature Adoption &amp; Platform Health Metrics</strong></p> <p><em>Define success metrics for new platform capabilities — adoption rates, error rates, configuration accuracy, permission incident rates. Iterate on features based on data and OEM program feedback.</em></p> <p><strong>• Ensure OEM Compliance &amp; Certification Readiness</strong></p> <p><em>Validate that platform capabilities meet OEM-mandated compliance, security, and certification standards. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><p><b>Summary:</b><br><br>The Senior Product Designer leads the design of complex and high-impact features across Tekion’s platform, ensuring scalable, intuitive, and visually consistent user experiences. This role partners closely with Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to define problems, explore solutions, and deliver elegant, user-centered designs. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong product vision, systems thinking, and mentorship capabilities. ​<br><br><b>Duties &amp; RESPONSIBILITIES: </b><br><br>• ​Lead the design of complex product areas from discovery to delivery, including user research, flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and prototypes<br>• ​Collaborate with stakeholders to define user problems, product strategy, and success metrics<br>• ​Facilitate and contribute to design critiques, cross-functional workshops, and ideation sessions<br>• ​Drive improvements to design systems, accessibility, and UX quality across the product<br>• ​Partner with developers to ensure accurate design implementation and iterate based on feedback<br>• ​Mentor junior designers and help uphold design best practices and team standards ​<br><br><b>Job Complexity:</b><br><br>Leads design efforts on complex product initiatives with broad scope and strategic impact ​<br><br><b>Required Supervision:</b><br><br>Operates independently and is trusted to lead critical projects with minimal oversight ​<br><br><b>Expertise:</b><br><br>Deep expertise in product design, UX research, and systems thinking; recognized for strategic insight and ability to influence product direction ​ ​<br><br><b> QUALIFICATIONS: </b><br><br>• ​5-7 years of experience in product design or UX, with a strong portfolio of end-to-end product work<br>• ​Expert proficiency in Figma and collaborative design tools<br>• ​Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects and mentor peers<br>• ​Strong grasp of accessibility standards, usability best practices, and responsive design<br>• ​Excellent storytelling, communication, and stakeholder management skills<br>• ​Bachelor’s degree in design, HCI, or a related field</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 14px;" data-contrast="auto">For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice </span><a style="font-size: 14px;" href="https://tekion.com/legal/privacy/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-notice"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">h</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">e</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">re</span></span></a>.</p></div>

title: Senior Software Development Test Engineer - AI
jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>About Tekion:</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong><br>We are looking for highly motivated Senior AI Software Development Engineers in Test (AISDET) to join Tekion’s ML Engineering team. Our team builds and ships the machine learning&nbsp;<br>models and AI agents that power the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) — from Service AI Agents and F&amp;I automation to the AI-powered Analytics Agent — trained on real-time data spanning 1,700+ dealership rooftops.<br>In this role, you will be responsible for building confidence in the quality, correctness, and reliability of the models and AI agents we deliver. You will work closely with ML Engineers, Data<br>Scientists, the AI Platform team, Product Management, and Applied AI teams to define robust validation strategies, automate testing across the model lifecycle, and ensure our AI features meet the highest quality bar before they reach dealers and their customers.Because you are testing AI systems, you will go beyond deterministic assertions: you will design<br>evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic model and agent outputs, measure accuracy and consistency, catch hallucinations and regressions, and continuously expand coverage. You will also use AI and LLMs yourself — to generate test cases, synthetic data, and automation scaffolding — raising both the speed and the depth of quality engineering.<br><br><br><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop a deep understanding of Tekion’s AI agents, ML models, business domains, and the data that feeds them.</li> <li>Own end-to-end quality for the ML models, AI agents, and AI-powered features shipped by the ML Engineering team.</li> <li>Design and implement automated testing frameworks for model inference, prompt pipelines, agentic workflows, RAG/retrieval systems, and the APIs that serve them.</li> <li>Validate model correctness, accuracy, latency, and behavioral consistency across model versions, prompt changes, and upgrades.</li> <li>Define and execute evaluation strategies for AI/LLM-powered capabilities by:</li> <li>Creating and curating evaluation datasets (evals) and ground-truth sets</li> <li>Measuring response accuracy, relevance, and consistency</li> <li>Identifying hallucinations, unsafe outputs, and edge cases</li> <li>Building LLM-as-judge and automated scoring pipelines</li> <li>Continuously improving evaluation coverage as models and agents evolve</li> <li>Use AI/LLMs to accelerate quality engineering — generating test cases, synthetic test data,and automation scaffolding.</li> <li>Build regression suites that detect quality drift when models, prompts, embeddings, or training data change.</li> <li>Validate integration of ML models and agents into ARC products, including end-to-end flows and fallback behavior.</li> <li>Drive root cause analysis for production model and behavioral issues, and partner with ML Engineers on preventive improvements.</li> <li>Define quality metrics, guardrails, and automated monitoring to detect model degradation before it impacts customers.</li> <li>Champion quality and evaluation engineering best practices across the ML Engineering organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br><br></strong><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li>5–8 years in SDET, quality engineering, or software engineering, with a strong track recordof building test automation frameworks.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python (preferred for ML tooling) and/or Java, with the ability to write production-quality automation code.</li> <li>Hands-on experience testing data-intensive or ML/AI systems — or a strong softwaretesting background with demonstrated ML/LLM fluency.</li> <li>Solid understanding of ML concepts: model training and inference, evaluation metrics (precision/recall, F1, etc.), and the non-deterministic nature of model outputs.</li> <li>Experience designing evaluation frameworks, or working with eval datasets, benchmarks, or LLM-as-judge approaches.</li> <li>Familiarity with LLM/agent concepts — prompting, RAG, embeddings, vector search — and generative failure modes (hallucination, drift, prompt sensitivity).</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD, test orchestration, and API/integration testing.</li> <li>Strong analytical and debugging skills; comfortable performing root cause analysis across model, data, and code layers.</li> <li>Excellent collaboration and communication skills to partner across ML, data, and product teams.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Nice to Have<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with ML/eval tooling such as MLflow, Weights &amp; Biases, Lang Smith, Ragas, Deep Eval, or provider eval suites.</li> <li>Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).</li> <li>Exposure to model observability, drift detection, and production ML monitoring.</li> <li>Experience testing agentic systems, tool use, or multi-step LLM workflows.</li> <li>Prior experience in a high-scale Saa S or data platform environment.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 14px;" data-contrast="auto">For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice </span><a style="font-size: 14px;" href="https://tekion.com/legal/privacy/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-notice"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">h</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">e</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">re</span></span></a>.</p></div>

Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><p>Job Description: Software Development Test Engineer II</p><p><b>Department:</b> Engineering</p><p><b>Summary:</b><br>The Software Development Test Engineer II contributes to the quality assurance and testing strategy for Tekion’s software products by designing, executing, and maintaining manual and automated test solutions for new and existing functionality. This role works closely with software engineers, product managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to validate requirements, identify defects, improve test coverage, and help ensure reliable product releases. The ideal candidate brings solid experience in software testing, growing expertise in automation, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced Agile development environment.</p><p><b>Duties and RESPONSIBILITIES: </b></p><ul><li>Design, develop, execute, and maintain test cases and test scripts for functional, regression, integration, and system testing</li><li>Create and enhance automated test scripts for recurring test scenarios and critical product workflows</li><li>Analyze product requirements, technical specifications, and user stories to ensure adequate test coverage and quality validation</li><li>Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects through resolution, partnering with developers to support root cause analysis</li><li>Validate new features, enhancements, bug fixes, and release candidates across web, mobile, APIs, and/or platform applications as applicable</li><li>Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and release readiness discussions</li><li>Collaborate with engineering, product, and Dev Ops teams to improve test strategies, test environments, and release quality</li><li>Maintain test documentation, test data, and traceability between requirements and test coverage</li><li>Support and execute API, database, and end-to-end testing where needed</li><li>Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, automation frameworks, and testing standards</li><li>Mentor junior test engineers or provide guidance on test execution, defect documentation, and quality best practices</li><li><b>Job Complexity:</b> Performs moderately complex testing and quality engineering work across multiple features or components. Requires balancing manual and automated testing responsibilities, identifying risks proactively, and contributing to quality improvements that support team-level delivery and release goals.</li><li><b>Required Supervision:</b> Operates under general supervision with the ability to manage routine testing activities independently. Receives guidance on complex technical issues, broader quality strategy, and high-risk release decisions.</li><li><b>Expertise:</b> Applies solid knowledge of software testing methodologies, test automation, defect lifecycle management, and Agile delivery practices. Demonstrates growing expertise in test planning, automation development, API validation, and cross-functional collaboration to improve product quality and release confidence.</li></ul><p><b> QUALIFICATIONS: </b></p><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field</li><li>2-4 years of experience in software testing, quality assurance, or software development</li><li>Working knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC), software testing lifecycle (STLC), and Agile methodologies</li><li>Experience designing and executing manual and automated test cases</li><li>Familiarity with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or similar</li><li>Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Java, Python, Java Script, or similar</li><li>Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, Test Rail, Azure Dev Ops, or equivalent</li><li>Understanding of API testing tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or similar is preferred</li><li>Basic knowledge of SQL, databases, and client-server or microservices architecture is preferred</li><li>Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and organizational skills</li><li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced environment</li></ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. title: Staff Product Manager
jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>About Tekion:</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><h2>Job Introduction</h2> <p>We are seeking a senior, technically strong Product Manager to own platform capabilities across one of our engineering Scrum teams while driving customer-facing outcomes and continuous improvement. This role requires close collaboration with Engineering, AI, and platform teams, along with hands-on understanding of event-driven systems, agentic AI integration, scalable service design, and data-driven product development.</p> <h2>Key Role &amp; Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own the product backlog for a Scrum team — writing clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature specifications aligned with business goals.</li> <li>Partner closely with Engineering and AI teams to deliver high-quality solutions across Java microservices, Kafka event pipelines, and agentic platform integrations.</li> <li>Collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to ensure seamless integrations, well-defined data contracts, and API alignment.</li> <li>Track success metrics, adoption, and outcomes — iterating rapidly based on data and field feedback.</li> <li>Author Intent definitions, Skill specifications, and Policy configurations for the agentic platform layer (PRDas-Code approach).</li> <li>Design and maintain golden dataset scenarios used to validate intelligent capabilities before release.</li> <li>Drive change management and adoption of new features, tools, and platform capabilities.</li> <li>Build and maintain automations using workflow tools (Zapier or equivalent) to streamline internal processes.</li> <li>Demonstrate strong understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, and authentication mechanisms; troubleshoot integration issues hands-on.</li> <li>Work with data teams to define schemas, reporting views, and analytics instrumentation.</li> <li>Facilitate prioritization discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and communicate trade-offs clearly across Engineering, Design, and Leadership.</li> </ul> <h2>Basic Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>6+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in platform, data-driven, or AI-enabled products.</li> <li>Strong experience collaborating with engineering teams on technical products — comfortable reading system designs, API specs, and data models.</li> <li>Proven analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset; experience defining and tracking product KPIs.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs, webhooks, and system integrations (ERP, CRM, data platforms, or cloud services).</li> <li>Familiarity with AI systems, LLM-based tools, and agentic AI patterns (intent routing, skill/policy design, MCP tools).</li> <li>Experience designing scalable, maintainable solution architectures in collaboration with engineering.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills; strong stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Structured problem-solving and critical thinking; ability to navigate complex system trade-offs.</li> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.</li> </ul> <h2>Preferred Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Experience authoring PRD-as-Code artifacts: Intent definitions, Skill specs, Policy configurations.</li> <li>Background in marketing technology, CDP, or customer data platforms.</li> <li>Experience with LMS platforms and user enablement programs.</li> <li>Prior experience in automotive retail or dealer technology.</li> </ul> <h2>Perks &amp; Benefits</h2> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation and generous stock options.</li> <li>Medical insurance coverage.</li> <li>Work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley's most dominant and successful companies</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="Text Run SCXW234200212 BCX8" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="Normal Text Run SCXW234200212 BCX8">Current&nbsp;</span><span class="Normal Text Run Spelling Error V2Themed SCXW234200212 BCX8">Tekion</span><span class="Normal Text Run SCXW234200212 BCX8">&nbsp;Employees – Please apply via Greenhouse Internal Job Board</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW234200212 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 14px;" data-contrast="auto">For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice </span><a style="font-size: 14px;" href="https://tekion.com/legal/privacy/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-notice"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">h</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">e</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">re</span></span></a>.</p></div>

jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>About Tekion:</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><p>ABOUT TEKION<br>Tekion is positively disrupting an industry that has seen little meaningful innovation in over 50 years. With the first cloud-native Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) and Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC), Tekion connects OEMs, dealers, and consumers through a single unified platform powered by real-time data, machine learning, and AI. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe, and is trusted by 1,700+ dealership rooftops globally.</p> <p><br>ROLE OVERVIEW<br>We are seeking a senior, technically strong Staff Product Manager to own dealer experience applications and integrations within Tekion's GM Digital Retail Platform (DRP) program. This is a high-visibility, end-to-end product ownership role — you will define the dealer-facing product experience while simultaneously owning the integration architecture that connects Tekion's AEC platform to GM's DRP infrastructure.</p> <p>You will operate at the intersection of OEM program management, platform engineering, and dealer-facing product design — serving as the connective tissue between GM's business and technical teams, Tekion's engineering organization, and the dealer community. This is an IC Staff PM role requiring deep technical fluency, strong stakeholder management across complex enterprise partnerships, and the ability to ship product in a fast-moving OEM program environment.</p> <p><br>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</p> <p>• Own Dealer Experience End-to-End<br>Define, prioritize, and drive the product roadmap for dealer-facing capabilities within GM DRP — spanning the deal configuration experience, digital retailing flows, F&amp;I presentation, and dealer portal workflows.<br>• Lead Integration Strategy &amp; Execution<br>Own the integration architecture between Tekion's AEC platform and GM's DRP infrastructure — including inventory syndication, pricing/deal data contracts, real-time status sync, and OEM-mandated API standards.<br>• Own the Scrum Team Backlog<br>Write clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature specifications. Maintain a well-groomed backlog that balances OEM program milestones, dealer experience improvements, and platform stability.<br>• Define &amp; Enforce Data Contracts<br>Collaborate with platform and data engineering teams to design robust API schemas, webhooks, and event-driven data flows; ensure data integrity across DMS, GM DRP, and third-party systems.<br>• Drive GM OEM &amp; Dealer Success Alignment<br>Act as the primary product interface for GM's business and technical teams; translate OEM program requirements into well-scoped product deliverables. Align with Dealer Success teams to capture and close field feedback loops.<br>• Define &amp; Track Success Metrics<br>Establish KPIs across dealer adoption, deal completion rates, integration reliability (uptime/latency), and error rates. Iterate rapidly based on data signals and dealer feedback.<br>• Troubleshoot Integrations Hands-On<br>Demonstrate technical depth in diagnosing API failures, data sync mismatches, and event pipeline issues. Partner with engineering to resolve root causes — not just triage.<br>• Facilitate Cross-Functional Prioritization<br>Navigate competing priorities across Engineering, GM OEM, Dealer Success, Design, and Platform teams. Communicate trade-offs with clarity to senior leadership.<br>• Drive Change Management &amp; Dealer Adoption<br>Partner with Dealer Success and enablement teams to build rollout plans, training assets, and adoption playbooks for new features and integration changes.<br>• Support Platform Scalability &amp; Compliance<br>Ensure all dealer experience features and integrations meet GM's compliance, security, and certification requirements. Contribute to quarterly OEM program reviews.</p> <p><br>SKILLS &amp; QUALIFICATIONS</p> <p>• 6+ years of Product Management experience<br>Preferably in platform products, OEM/enterprise integrations, or digital retail technology.<br>• Strong technical command of system integrations<br>Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs, webhooks, event-driven architectures (Kafka or equivalent), and API authentication patterns.<br>• Proven ability to translate OEM or enterprise requirements into product<br>Experience working directly with large enterprise partners (OEMs, enterprise Saa S customers) and decomposing complex requirements into actionable roadmaps.<br>• Data-driven product mindset<br>Comfortable defining schemas, reporting views, and analytics instrumentation. Experience tracking and iterating on product KPIs end-to-end.<br>• Excellent stakeholder management<br>Demonstrated ability to align diverse stakeholders — engineering, OEM business teams, field/dealer success, and executive leadership — across complex programs.<br>• Strong written and verbal communication<br>Ability to author crisp product specs, integration design docs, and executive-level summaries equally well.<br>• Bachelor's or Master's degree in CS, IT, Engineering, Business, or a related field</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>GOOD TO HAVE</p> <p>• Experience in automotive retail technology, DMS platforms, or dealer-facing digital products.<br>• Familiarity with OEM digital retail programs, or certified DMS integrations.<br>• Background in automotive deal desking, F&amp;I workflows, or vehicle configuration systems.<br>• Experience working with AI/ML-powered platform capabilities or agentic integrations.<br>• Prior exposure to OEM certification and compliance processes.</p> <p><br>WHAT YOU’LL OWN AT TEKION</p> <p>This role gives you end-to-end ownership of a strategic OEM program — rare for a Staff PM. You will:</p> <p>• Shape the dealer experience for one of the largest automotive OEM digital retail programs in the US.<br>• Own the full integration surface between Tekion AEC and GM DRP — not just feature delivery.<br>• Build lasting partnerships with GM's engineering and business teams, influencing roadmap at the OEM level.<br>• Operate at Staff-level scope with direct executive visibility and program accountability.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 14px;" data-contrast="auto">For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice </span><a style="font-size: 14px;" href="https://tekion.com/legal/privacy/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-notice"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">h</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">e</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">re</span></span></a>.</p></div>

jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>About Tekion:</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><div class="x_element To Proof"><strong data-olk-copy-source="Message Body">About the Role</strong></div> <div class="x_element To Proof">We are looking for a highly motivated individuals to join Tekion's Enterprise Data Platform team. Our platform powers the organization's data lake and serves as the foundation for a wide range of data products, analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and customer-facing experiences.</div> <div class="x_element To Proof">In this role, you will be responsible for building confidence in the quality, reliability, and correctness of data across the platform. You will work closely with Data Engineering, Product Management, Analytics, and AI teams to define robust validation strategies, automate testing, and ensure that data products meet the highest quality standards.</div> <div class="x_element To Proof">As Tekion expands its AI-powered Analytics Agent, you will also play a key role in validating user intents, defining evaluation frameworks, and ensuring the accuracy and consistency of AI-generated insights.<br><br></div> <div class="x_element To Proof"><strong>What You'll Do</strong></div> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Develop a deep understanding of Tekion's enterprise data model, business domains, and data flows.</li> <li>Own end-to-end quality for data products published through the Enterprise Data Platform.</li> <li>Design and implement automated testing frameworks for data pipelines, transformations, APIs, and platform capabilities.</li> <li>Validate data correctness, completeness, consistency, freshness, and lineage across the data platform.</li> <li>Build scalable reconciliation frameworks to compare Data Lake outputs against source systems, including:</li> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Operational databases</li> <li>Product UIs</li> <li>Upstream services</li> <li>Business reports and dashboards</li> </ul> <li>Define data quality metrics, validation rules, and automated monitoring to detect anomalies before Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><p><strong>About the ROLE: &nbsp;<br></strong><br>We are looking for a highly motivated AI Software Development Engineer in Test to join Tekion’s AI Platform team. You will work closely with Platform and Infrastructure Engineers, ML Engineers, and Product Management to define robust validation strategies, automate testing across platform services and SDKs, and ensure the platform behaves correctlyand scales under the demands of a growing fleet of AI agents.<br>As the platform expands to serve 100+ AI agents, you will help define quality and evaluation frameworks for platform-level AI services - validating model-serving correctness, feature integrity, and the reliability of the tooling teams depend on. You will also use AI and LLMs to accelerate test generation and automation across the platform.<br><br><br><strong>What You’ll Do :&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop a deep understanding of Tekion’s AI Platform architecture, services, data/feature flows, and the ML lifecycle it supports.</li> <li>Own end-to-end quality for platform capabilities - feature pipelines, training and serving infrastructure, model registry, deployment pipelines, LLM gateways, and vector/data stores.</li> <li>Design and implement automated testing frameworks for platform APIs, SDKs, services, and infrastructure components.</li> <li>Validate the correctness, completeness, and consistency of features and model inputs/outputs as they move through the platform.</li> <li>Test model-serving and inference services for correctness, latency, throughput, scalability, and reliability under load.</li> <li>Build regression and reconciliation suites for large-scale platform changes, migrations, and&nbsp;<br>version upgrades.</li> <li>Validate platform capabilities such as ingestion, feature computation, model deployment/rollback, multi-tenancy, and governance.</li> <li>Define quality metrics and SLO validation, with automated monitoring to detect platform anomalies before they impact ML teams or customers.</li> <li>Contribute to evaluation frameworks for platform-level AI services (e.g., serving correctness, feature integrity, eval-infrastructure reliability).</li> <li>Use AI/LLMs to accelerate quality engineering - generating tests, synthetic data, and automation scaffolding.</li> <li>Drive root cause analysis for production platform issues and partner with engineering teams on preventive improvements.</li> <li>Champion quality engineering and reliability best practices across the AI Platform organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>What We’re Looking For<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years in SDET, quality engineering, or software engineering, with strong experience building automation frameworks for platform, infrastructure, or backend services.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java/Go, with the ability to write productionquality automation and tooling.</li> <li>Experience testing distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, or ML/data platforms.</li> <li>Solid understanding of ML lifecycle components - feature stores, training/serving, model registry, deployment - or a strong platform-testing background with ML fluency.</li> <li>Experience with performance, load, and scalability testing.</li> <li>Familiarity with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure).</li> <li>Understanding of LLM/ML failure modes and evaluation concepts.</li> <li>Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across service, data, and infrastructure layers.</li> <li>Excellent collaboration and communication skills.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Nice to Have<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with ML platform tools (MLflow, Feast, KServe/Seldon, Ray, Kubeflow, Sage Maker/Vertex AI) or LLM infra (v LLM, model gateways, vector DBs such as Milvus/Pinecone).</li> <li>Experience with observability and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog).</li> <li>Experience testing multi-tenant, high-throughput Saa S platforms.</li> <li>Contributions to internal test frameworks or developer tooling.</li> <li>Exposure to chaos or reliability engineering</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>About Tekion:</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong><br>We are looking for a highly motivated Senior SDET – AI Evaluation to join Tekion’s AI Platform&nbsp; team. Evaluation is the backbone of trustworthy AI: as Tekion scales from a handful of AI agents<br>to 100+ across Service, Sales, F&amp;I, and Analytics, this role builds the evaluation platform and frameworks that let every ML team measure, trust, and improve the quality of AI outputs.In this role, you will be responsible for defining and building Tekion’s AI evaluation capabilities as a shared platform service. You will work closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, the AI Platform team, and Product Management to design evaluation datasets, automated scoring pipelines, and quality metrics that quantify the accuracy, consistency, and safety of AIgenerated outputs across the organization. You will own the systems that answer “is this model or agent good enough to ship, and is it&nbsp;<br>staying good in production?” — from offline benchmarks and LLM-as-judge pipelines to online evaluation and continuous quality monitoring. You will also use AI and LLMs to scale evaluation itself, building automated judges and synthetic datasets that expand coverage faster than manual review ever could.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop a deep understanding of Tekion’s AI agents, ML models, and the quality dimensions that matter for each business domain.</li> <li>Design, enhance, and own Tekion’s AI evaluation infrastructure as a shared capability used across ML teams.</li> <li>Create, curate, and maintain evaluation datasets (evals) and golden/ground-truth sets across use cases and domains.</li> <li>Define quality metrics for AI outputs — accuracy, relevance, faithfulness/groundedness, consistency, safety, and task success.</li> <li>Build automated scoring pipelines, including LLM-as-judge, rubric-based, and referencebased evaluation methods.</li> <li>Validate user intents and measure response accuracy and consistency for AI-powered capabilities such as the Analytics Agent.</li> <li>Identify hallucinations, unsafe or biased outputs, and edge cases; design targeted eval suites to catch them.</li> <li>Build both offline evaluation (pre-release benchmarking) and online evaluation (production quality monitoring, A/B, drift detection).</li> <li>Establish evaluation gates in CI/CD so model, prompt, or data changes are quality-checkedbefore release.</li> <li>Develop dashboards and reporting that make AI quality visible and actionable for ML and product teams.</li> <li>Use AI/LLMs to scale evaluation — automated judges, synthetic data generation, and eval \tooling</li> <li>Champion evaluation and responsible-AI quality best practices across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><br>What We’re Looking For</p> <ul> <li>5–8 years in SDET, quality engineering, ML engineering, or data science, with hands-on experience building evaluation or measurement systems — or a strong SDET background with deep LLM/ML fluency.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python, with the ability to build robust, reusable evaluation pipelines and tooling.</li> <li>Deep understanding of ML/LLM evaluation, benchmark design, and the pitfalls of evaluating non-deterministic systems.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with LLM-as-judge, rubric-based scoring, or human-in-the-loop evaluation.</li> <li>Solid grasp of LLM/agent concepts — prompting, RAG, embeddings, tool use — and generative failure modes (hallucination, drift, prompt sensitivity, bias).</li> <li>Experience designing and curating datasets, including labeling/annotation strategy and data quality.</li> <li>Strong statistical intuition for interpreting eval results and significance.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills to translate quality signals into decisions for ML and product teams.</li> </ul> <p><br>Nice to Have<br>• Experience with eval frameworks/tools such as Ragas, Deep Eval, Lang Smith, Tru Lens, Promptfoo, HELM, or provider eval suites.<br>• Experience building online evaluation, guardrails, or production model monitoring.<br>• Familiarity with responsible AI / safety evaluation and red-teaming.<br>• Experience with experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights &amp; Biases) and A/B testing.<br>• Prior work standing up evaluation as a platform capability for multiple teams</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 14px;" data-contrast="auto">For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice </span><a style="font-size: 14px;" href="https://tekion.com/legal/privacy/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-notice"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">h</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">e</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">re</span></span></a>.</p></div>

adapters) — proven ability to design domain cores fully decoupled from infrastructure layers.</p> <p>• Strong Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.x expertise with event-driven, microservices-first design.&nbsp;</p> <p>• Strong experience with Kafka — consumer groups, partition design, offset management, idempotent consumers, and event-driven service integration.</p> <p>• Proven experience with Mongo DB: document schema design, indexing, aggregation pipelines, and multi tenant isolation patterns.</p> <p>• Strong Postgre SQL experience: complex schema design, query optimization, migration management.</p> <p>• Experience with Cosmos DB or equivalent globally distributed key-value stores: partition key design, consistency tuning, high-throughput read/write patterns.</p> <p>• Solid experience with Elasticsearch: index design, search query optimization, relevance tuning.</p> <p>• Experience with Redis or Aerospike for high-throughput caching and session/state management.</p> <p>• Strong understanding of distributed systems: service boundaries, data consistency, idempotency, retries, and circuit breaking on AWS (EKS, MSK).</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Preferred Skills</strong></p> <p>• Experience with Temporal for durable workflow orchestration.&nbsp;</p> <p>• Familiarity with MCP tool registration patterns and agentic platform integration.</p> <p>• Working knowledge of Python for AI/ML pipeline integration (scoring models, feature serving, LLM gateway patterns).</p> <p>• Prior experience building data platforms, real-time analytics systems, or AI-native Saa S products.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Perks &amp;
